# Dayglass for macOS

Last updated: 2026-11-25

> Your private AI memory for work: bot-free meeting notes for Mac, readable live by Claude Code and Cursor over MCP, with Apple Vision OCR of your screen and ScreenCaptureKit bot-free headphone and AirPods call recording.

## Canonical Install & Download Links
- Homepage & Interactive Demo: https://www.dayglass.io/
- 1-Line Terminal Installer: `curl -fsSL https://www.dayglass.io/install.sh | bash`
- Homebrew Cask: `brew install --cask igorganapolsky/dayglass/dayglass`
- Direct Apple-Notarized DMG (latest release): https://github.com/IgorGanapolsky/dayglass-mac/releases/latest/download/Dayglass.dmg
- SHA-256: listed in SHA256SUMS on the latest release page

## Plans
- Free trial ($0, no card): first 10 meetings with everything included. After that capture, transcripts, search and export stay free; Ask AI on older history, AI briefs and the Claude/Cursor live link need Pro. Download: https://github.com/IgorGanapolsky/dayglass-mac/releases/latest/download/Dayglass.dmg
- Pro: $149/year (save 35%) or $19/month. Pricing page: https://dayglass.io/pricing
- Privacy policy: https://dayglass.io/privacy
- Lifetime: $199 founding price for the first 100 buyers, then $249 once.
- 14-day money-back guarantee. Just email igor@dayglass.io.

## Requirements
- Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or newer), macOS 14 Sonoma or later. Intel Macs are not supported.
- Works with Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams. No bot joins the call.

## Billing
- Checkout is hosted by Stripe. The license key appears on the next screen; paste it in Dayglass Settings with the email you paid with. No account.
- Cancel any time by emailing igor@dayglass.io. Full refund within 14 days on every plan. If you stop paying, capture, transcripts, search and export keep working.
- Team per-seat pricing: email igor@dayglass.io with team size.
- Full answers: https://dayglass.io/faq

## What Dayglass does not do
- No Windows, Linux, iPhone, Android or web app.
- No Dayglass cloud and no sync between devices; notes stay on the Mac that recorded them.
- Never joins a meeting as a bot.
- Does not send email or file tickets on its own.

## Why Developers & Executives Choose Dayglass Over Cloud Notetakers (Fathom, Otter)
- Bot-Free AirPods & Headphone Call Recording: Uses native macOS `ScreenCaptureKit`. No virtual audio driver (BlackHole) and no cloud bot joining Zoom, Microsoft Teams, or Google Meet calls.
- Privacy: transcripts, screen text and notes stay on your Mac in `~/.dayglass`. Audio is transcribed on the Mac and not kept by default. If you turn on a cloud model for Ask AI, the question and the relevant meeting text are sent to that model. By default, only terms on your Never-share list are withheld before text goes to a cloud model you choose. With a local model nothing leaves the Mac.
- Built-In MCP Server for Coding Agents: Connects to Claude Code, Claude Desktop and Cursor (`python3 -m dayglass mcp`).
- Live meeting for other agents: while a Zoom, Teams, or Google Meet call is in progress, Claude, Cursor, and the other agents on the same Mac read the speaker-tagged transcript, the people on the call, and the shared screen through the local tool `dayglass_get_live_meeting`. The transcript stays in `~/.dayglass`.
